podcast.body: A "secret document" allegedly states that Poison guitarist CC Deville played uncredited lead guitar on U2's song "Mysterious Ways." This credit was supposedly withheld to prevent ruining Deville's image, a secret later divulged by Poison's singer to his fans.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song by U2 reached number one on the Modern Rock Chart in late November 1991, preceding and succeeding Nirvana's "Smells Like Teen Spirit" during its one-week reign. "it was bookended on either side by a pair of songs by college radio veterans U2, The Fly and Mysterious Ways."
